title: Enheduanna's hymns at Ur
summary: Enheduanna, high priestess of the moon god at Ur and daughter of Sargon of Akkad, is celebrated as the earliest known named author; works like the Exaltation of Inanna speak in her voice.
why: Possibly the first author in history known by name.

unsung.contribution: Celebrated as the earliest known named author, credited with hymns such as the Exaltation of Inanna.
unsung.recognition: Memory of her and her works was lost after the First Babylonian Empire; scholars debate whether she wrote them.
